text:
## Learning & Improvement  
**Root Cause Analysis:**
- Identify systemic complaints (same issue, multiple customers)
- Analyze root cause
- Implement corrective action
- Monitor effectiveness  
**Examples:**
- High "slow processing" complaints → Review SOP, add resources
- Multiple fee disputes → Improve T&C clarity, better disclosure
- Fraud complaints → Strengthen security measures

raw_entities.name: Learning & Improvement Policy
raw_entities.description: Establishes the mandatory framework for identifying systemic complaints, analyzing underlying root causes, implementing corrective actions, and monitoring their effectiveness to ensure continuous operational improvement.

raw_entities.name: Systemic Complaint Identification Requirement
raw_entities.description: Staff must proactively identify systemic complaints characterized by the same issue affecting multiple customers to trigger further analysis.
context: - Identify systemic complaints (same issue, multiple customers)

raw_entities.name: Root Cause Analysis Mandate
raw_entities.description: Staff are required to conduct a thorough analysis of the underlying root cause for all identified systemic complaints.

raw_entities.name: Corrective Action Implementation Obligation
raw_entities.description: Staff must implement targeted corrective actions to address the root causes of identified complaints and prevent recurrence.

raw_entities.name: Effectiveness Monitoring Requirement
raw_entities.description: Staff must continuously monitor the effectiveness of implemented corrective actions to ensure they resolve the underlying issues.

raw_entities.name: SOP Review and Resource Addition for Processing Delays
raw_entities.description: In cases of high slow processing complaints, staff must review standard operating procedures and allocate additional resources to mitigate delays.
context: - High "slow processing" complaints → Review SOP, add resources

raw_entities.name: Terms and Conditions Clarity Improvement for Fee Disputes
raw_entities.description: When multiple fee disputes arise, staff must improve the clarity of terms and conditions and enhance customer disclosure practices.
context: - Multiple fee disputes → Improve T&C clarity, better disclosure

raw_entities.name: Security Strengthening for Fraud Complaints
raw_entities.description: In response to fraud complaints, staff are mandated to strengthen existing security measures to prevent further unauthorized activity.

raw_entities.name: Systemic Complaint Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk of recurring operational failures affecting multiple customers simultaneously, requiring systemic identification and root cause analysis.
context: Identify systemic complaints (same issue, multiple customers)

raw_entities.name: Service Processing Delay Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk of delayed service delivery leading to customer dissatisfaction and complaints, necessitating SOP review and resource allocation.

raw_entities.name: Fee Dispute Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk of customer disagreements regarding fees, driven by unclear terms and insufficient disclosure.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk of fraudulent activity resulting in customer complaints, requiring enhanced security measures and corrective actions.

raw_entities.name: Standard Operating Procedure Review
raw_entities.description: A mandatory operational safeguard requiring the review of existing SOPs to identify procedural gaps when slow processing complaints are high.
context: High "slow processing" complaints → Review SOP, add resources

raw_entities.name: Resource Allocation Enhancement
raw_entities.description: An operational control requiring the addition of staff or resources to address capacity constraints causing processing delays.
context: High "slow processing" complaints → Review SOP, add resources

raw_entities.name: Disclosure and Clarity Improvement
raw_entities.description: A customer-facing control requiring the enhancement of terms and conditions clarity and disclosure practices to prevent fee disputes.
context: Multiple fee disputes → Improve T&C clarity, better disclosure

raw_entities.name: Security Measure Strengthening
raw_entities.description: A protective safeguard requiring the enhancement of technical and procedural security controls in response to fraud complaints.

raw_entities.name: Affected Customers
raw_entities.description: Customers impacted by systemic issues or specific complaint types, serving as the primary subjects for root cause analysis and corrective action implementation.
